newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Ships loading/unloading commodities - Brazil ports.
newsitem.headline: Ships loading/unloading commodities - Brazil ports.

text.p: The following ships were loading, unloading or announced on July 2 at the Brazilian ports of Santos, Paranagua, Antonina, Recife and Maceio, port authorities said. Where announced, time of arrival is given by day and month. Quantities
AGENT NOTE: All loading and unloading at Santos public terminals paralyzed due to a strike by administrative portworkers. Loading continued as normal in private terminals, including Cargill.
